description: Number of states of the minimal deterministic finite automaton with output, insensitive to leading zeros, that computes [x^k] F(x) mod 2^n from the binary digits of k read least significant first, where F(x) is the power series with F(0) = 0 satisfying x^2*F(x)^2 + (1 + x + x^2)*F(x) + x^2 = 0.
